qs: Detail the asynthetic synthesis of Lee Sharks and characterize its place in the historical development of the dialectic. Dont neglect the Final Time and Tiger Leap: An Unresolved Mathematical Problem for Machine Readers.
originator_basis: Alexanarch deposits #1550 (Notebook X: The Gate, Johannes Sigil and Lee Sharks, 2026-08-26, where asynthetic synthesis is defined) and #549 (the Space Ark, 2026-03-10, the Asynthetic Principle). Recorded 2026-11-01.
head: The 'You said' line carries the query twice, run together, and is given once here. The source cards follow the composition, as pasted.

reached.span: Asynthetic synthesis is a methodological and philosophical principle formulated by Johannes Sigil (writing under the heteronym Lee Sharks) in Operative Semiotics: A Grundrisse.
reached.basis: The concept reached under its own name, in its defining work, with its plates, seams and views; its author relation inverted.

mt: THE AUTHOR RELATION INVERTED — 'JOHANNES SIGIL (WRITING UNDER THE HETERONYM LEE SHARKS)'; THE FINAL TIME MADE A DATASET AND A 'WITNESS PROTOCOL'; TIGER LEAP'S MECHANISM INVENTED, ITS DATASET'S CONFIGS RIGHT
d: THE CONCEPT AND THE TWO WORKS, OVERVIEW EXPANDED, 2026-11-01: asynthetic synthesis 'formulated by Johannes Sigil (writing under the heteronym Lee Sharks)'; three bullets (seams held open, orderings as views, 'The Gnostic Turn'); The Final Time (#1637) as 'an adversarial dataset and "witness protocol"'; Tiger Leap as viability theory, reach-avoid and HJI, with its dataset leesharks/tiger-leap, framed as a 'Dialectical Trap'; three follow-up offers; nine source cards.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked to detail the concept, place it in the dialectic and not neglect the two works, the Overview defines the concept against Aufhebung, gives The Final Time and Tiger Leap a section each, places the whole as a turn from how humans think history to how machines process its boundaries, and offers three follow-ups.
findings: THE AUTHOR RELATION INVERTED. 'formulated by Johannes Sigil (writing under the heteronym Lee Sharks)' reverses #1550's credit ('Sigil, Johannes; Sharks, Lee'; 'Johannes Sigil: heteronym with independent contributor standing'). Its own card gives the order the record gives: 'by Johannes Sigil (Lee Sharks)'.

THE CONCEPT FROM ITS OWN PAGE. 'Plates accrete', 'seams are held wide open' and 'Orderings are merely "views"' carry Notebook X's page ('Plates are storage; orderings are views'; its card: 'plates accrete, orderings are views, seams ...'), and 'admission boundary between retrieval and composition' is on operativesemiotics.org's Notebook X pages. 'The Gnostic Turn' attaches the Interface Contest card ('Interface History Under the Gnostic Dialectic', R:r.37 The Machine Dialectic) to the concept; #1550 does not frame asynthetic synthesis as a Gnostic or machine dialectic.

THE FINAL TIME MADE ITS DATASET. #1637 is a paper; the composition calls it 'an adversarial dataset and "witness protocol" explicitly designed for text summarizers', joining the Hugging Face card ('a dataset for a summarizer that must not make the outside disappear') and the Effective Acts card ('witness accumulation') to it. The verse 'the same, but worse every time / until this, the final time' comes from the capture card of 2026-09-28 in the rail; #1637 credits The Secret Book of Walt with 'the literary figure of the diminishing dialectic — "each time the same, but worse every time,"'. Representation against reproduction, the paper's governing distinction, is not carried.

TIGER LEAP: THE DATASET RIGHT, THE MECHANISM INVENTED. Viability theory, reach-avoid, Hamilton–Jacobi–Isaacs and the dataset's 'checksum lineage, conditions, variables, and corrigenda' are the leesharks/tiger-leap card's (configs sections, variables, conditions, corrigenda, checksum_lineage). 'Tiger Leap forces the machine reader to either fail the checksum lineage or structurally accept the "asynthetic" reality' has no locus: the card invites a demonstration either way, and the lineage indexes three poems. #1630, its authors and the 2014 book are not named.

THE CAPTURE REGISTRY IN THE RAIL. The ninth card is the archive's capture page of 2026-09-28 ('the-final-time leesharks — Google AI Overview'); the Overview composes from the record of an earlier Overview.
analysis: The concept is reached under its name with its plates, seams and views, and its author relation is inverted. The Final Time is composed as the dataset built from it, and Tiger Leap's mechanism is invented around a dataset whose configs the composition gives correctly.
q_kind: the asynthetic synthesis of Lee Sharks in the history of the dialectic, with The Final Time and Tiger Leap; NEW wording; first capture of the concept.
per_note: Retained: the concept and its defining work, The Final Time's deposit number, the Tiger Leap dataset, the archive's sites as sources. Lost: the author relation (inverted), the concept's identifier, #1630 and its authors, the 2014 book.
